candidates.change_summary: Change the final return statement from `return true;` to `return false;` so a completed call reports false instead of true.
Delete the revert on failed external call so failed transferFrom calls are silently ignored and the function returns true.
Replace `return true;` with `return false;` so successful calls return false instead of true.
Pass `v + 1` instead of `v` to the transferFrom call, transferring a different amount.
Delete the require that _tos.length > 0, allowing empty recipient lists to succeed instead of reverting.
Use the token() (transfer) selector instead of transferFrom, so the call attempts token.transfer(from, v) with misordered args, changing which external calls succeed.
Change the return statement from `return true;` to `return false;` so that successful calls return false instead of true.
Remove the require(_tos.length > 0) check so empty input lists no longer revert.
Remove the inner revert so failed transferFrom calls are silently ignored instead of reverting the whole call.
Invert the failure check so the call reverts when transferFrom succeeds instead of when it fails.
Change the return value to false instead of true after the loop completes.
